note: Two checked [[errata.field]] entries give KOD's original competing descriptions, so the original's description is withheld and KOD's carry is refused as stale rather than publishing one of them for 2005-2014. RKOD's original is delivered under TOKEN, which [[identity.route]] sends to SYC_A; its carry is refused as stale rather than adding an occurrence under the unrouted token, and RKOD keeps its routed 2015-2023 state. DATUM's original is retyped by an [[errata.data_type]] the carry does not replay, so its carry is refused as stale rather than adding 2005-2014 with the uncorrected type. LANK's [[errata.column]] names TOKEN too; the mint is refused as stale rather than minting under the unrouted token. ALT's original has two physical alternatives under one record key that agree on the guarded prose but not on data_type; its carry is refused as stale rather than copying one of them, and ALT keeps its documented years. DUP has two carries: the first adds 2005-2014, and the second (2010-2012) reaches those carried years, so it is refused as stale. PER's period is widened to 2010-2023 by an [[errata.occurrence_period]], so its carry (2005-2012) is refused as stale rather than checked against the uncorrected scope. REP's [[errata.field]] corrects its code-list pointer; copied coding binds from the original's own fields, so its carry is refused as stale rather than coding 2005-2014 from the uncorrected pointer.
fails_if: `compile_occurrence_corrections` replays the last of competing corrections onto a carry (KOD gains 2005-2014 with one description), emits a carry with the uncorrected type of an original an [[errata.data_type]] retypes (DATUM gains 2005-2014), or emits a carry or mints a held column under a routed token's raw variant (the register is withheld as unnamed_delivered_variant and RKOD loses its routed state), or builds a carry from one of several disagreeing physical alternatives (the build aborts: a copied field must equal every checked donor alternative), lets a second carry claim years an earlier carry of the same original already carries (DUP's 2010-2012 is stated twice, and no stale issue names carry 6), or checks a carry against the uncorrected scope of an original an [[errata.occurrence_period]] widens (PER's 2010-2012 is claimed twice, and no stale issue names carry 7), or carries an original whose code-list pointer a checked [[errata.field]] corrects (REP gains 2005-2014 coded from the uncorrected pointer, and no stale issue names carry 8)
